title: onvif-tt run results
description: Structured output emitted by `onvif-tt run --json-report <file>`. One JSON object per run. LLM agents read `results[]` to interpret outcomes and use `last_request` / `last_response` for follow-up reasoning.

target.description: DUT host[:port] the run was pointed at. May be null when the runner ran without --target.

schema_violations.description: Run-level roll-up: one entry per DISTINCT structural schema violation, deduplicated across tests. A single malformed response is hit by every test that calls that operation, so the per-result `schema_violations` counts failures while this counts defects. Absent when the run found none.

path.description: Element path from the response root, e.g. GetEventPropertiesResponse/MessageContentFilterDialect.

tests.description: IDs of the tests that received this violation.

SchemaViolationCode.description: missing-element: a child declared minOccurs>=1 was absent. bad-enum: element text outside its type's enumeration. missing-attribute: a use="required" attribute was absent.

id.description: Spec test ID (e.g. DEVICE-1-1-2) or LOCAL-* for tool-author tests.

duration_s.description: Wall-clock seconds spent in the test body.

longrepr.description: pytest's failure or skip representation. Empty for clean passes.

xfail_reason.description: Set when status is xfailed/xpassed; mirrors the reason attached to the test's xfail_on matcher.

profiles.description: ONVIF Profiles this test claims to validate.

mandatory.description: True if the test is mandatory under at least one of its profiles.

last_request.description: Pretty-printed XML of the last SOAP request the DUT received in this test. Useful for LLM-driven debugging.

last_response.description: Pretty-printed XML of the last SOAP response the DUT sent in this test.

wsa_violations.description: WS-Addressing defects observed in responses during this test. Recorded, not fatal — see runtime/wsa_validator.py. Absent when there were none.

schema_violations.description: Structural schema defects in responses this test received: a mandatory element or attribute absent, or a value outside its enumeration. These FAIL the test — assertions may have passed, but they ran on data the ONVIF schema does not permit. Absent when there were none.

operation.description: ONVIF operation whose response carried the defect.
